source_review.notes: Reviewed the official EDBT RUM paper; primary Monkey, Dostoevsky, LSM compaction-design-space, and WiscKey papers; current official RocksDB tuning, universal-compaction, and performance-context documentation; and current official Cassandra UCS documentation. All nine final destinations returned HTTP 200. Product counters, defaults, and trade-offs remain scoped to cited implementations and stated measurement boundaries.

evidence: Checked logical, database, host, device, read-source/block/byte, resident/peak/provisioned, and live-data quantities retain distinct names and boundaries.
Checked dominance uses componentwise minimization with at least one strict inequality and normalized score uses positive targets and nonnegative weights.
Checked zero-result reads are represented by per-query sources, blocks, I/O, or bytes rather than division by zero logical result bytes.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Milliseconds, ratios, bytes, I/O operations, CPU, and cost are never directly combined without normalization and declared interpretation.

evidence: Recomputed model balanced scores: leveled 0.9091, tiered 1.0159, and hybrid 0.8816; read-heavy selects leveled and write-heavy selects tiered.
Recomputed examples as database WA 8, device WA 1.5, aligned NAND/logical 12, resident SA 0.84, and peak SA 1.40.
Recomputed exercise ratios: database WA 6.2, device WA 1.3, NAND/logical 8.84, and resident/peak/provisioned SA 0.85/1.375/1.75.
Recomputed Exercise 3 scores A=0.86923 and B=0.89231 under the declared targets/weights.
numerical_recomputation.notes: All candidate measurements are educational fixtures without empirical uncertainty; ratios are valid only for their named boundaries.

evidence: Verified adjacent amplification ratios multiply only when the intermediate numerator/denominator, workload, tenant, and interval cancel exactly.
Verified Pareto filtering cannot choose a universal optimum and hard constraints logically precede weighted scoring.
Verified normalized weighted cost is dimensionless under positive targets but remains dependent on targets, weights, evidence comparability, and omitted objectives.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: RUM and simplified B-tree/LSM statements are model-guided trade-off principles, not universal empirical lower bounds for arbitrary implementations.

evidence: Reviewed zero-result reads, empty or changing logical-live denominator, compression below-one ratios, debt at interval boundaries, cache warm/cold state, and peak versus steady space.
Reviewed point hit/miss, short/long ranges, inserts/updates/deletes/TTL, key/value size, skew, burst/stall, snapshots, pinned files, recovery, repair, and migration.
Reviewed filesystem/RAID/device/co-tenant effects, replication/object storage, value-log GC, compression CPU, coordinated omission, uncertainty overlap, and workload drift.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: The executable model excludes correctness, memory/CPU, cache, device, network, recovery, peak space, uncertainty, and runtime behavior.

evidence: The finite model independently computes componentwise dominance and confirms all three candidates remain on the frontier.
It applies p99<=7 and SA<=1.30 before scoring, retaining leveled/hybrid and rejecting tiered regardless of tiered's write-heavy score.
Exact output checks candidate/frontier/feasible counts, each balanced score, constrained and sensitivity winners, score direction, and aggregate validity.
invariant_checking.notes: The model's fixed tuples and float arithmetic demonstrate decision flow only and do not validate measured candidate values.

evidence: Reviewed metric-integrity proof from logical semantics and aligned layers through raw-counter provenance and rejection of boundary-mismatched comparisons.
Reviewed decision proof from hard constraints through comparable measurement, Pareto reduction, normalized weighting, sensitivity, and operational supportability.
Reviewed steady-state evidence proof across preconditioning, stationary debt/shape, offered load, pending work, repetitions, failures, migration, and rollback.
proof_review.notes: Proof obligations guide evidence review; no formal optimization, concrete storage engine, hardware stack, or production trace was verified.

evidence: Metric-integrity, decision, and steady-state structures are separately labeled with explicit premises.
Analytical cost intuition, RUM framing, candidate scores, design-lever effects, and recommendations retain assumption and workload qualifiers.
The model explicitly denies confidence, runtime measurement, universal optimality, production performance, and omitted-layer coverage.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Source reachability, arithmetic recomputation, snippet execution, and validator success are not represented as independent academic or production review.

evidence: The standard-library Python model passed exact fourteen-line stdout, empty stderr, and zero exit status under the repository verifier.
Independent computation reproduced all model scores, sensitivity winners, layer ratios, space ratios, and exercise calculations.
All nine final external destinations returned HTTP 200 and repository-local Markdown/front-matter/link/snippet checks passed before review.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No B-tree, LSM, value-log, database, filesystem, SSD, network, replica, compression, cache, workload, fault, recovery, migration, endurance, cost, or steady-state benchmark was run.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter defines amplification as a vector at named boundaries, places semantics and service constraints ahead of preferences, and uses Pareto/sensitivity analysis to prevent a fixture score from becoming a universal recommendation.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed engine/host/device/network counter alignment, query classes, compression, caches, geometry, value separation, replication, steady state, debt, tails/peaks, uncertainty, canaries, migration, and rollback as production decision requirements.

pedagogical_review.notes: The one-page review establishes decision order; the executable model exposes feasibility, dominance, normalization, and sensitivity; ten examples make boundary errors concrete; and five matched exercises require computation plus measurement/adoption design.

limitations: Internal authoring, primary/official-source, mathematical, bounded executable-model, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external academic, Athanassoulis, Kester, Dayan, Idreos, RocksDB, Cassandra, WiscKey, database, filesystem, hardware, performance, economics, sustainability, or independent practitioner review is claimed. The chapter and model prove neither a universal RUM/LSM optimum, candidate measurements, production data structure, counter correctness, steady state, device endurance, workload fitness, certification, nor deployment readiness.
